location_exception_reason: Bunk House Portable Toilets are standardised prefabricated cabin units; location of manufacture or deployment does not alter the product's functional specification or buyer decision criteria. Buyers select by material (FRP/MS), capacity, configuration, and features — not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, Contractor) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. A 'Bunk House Portable Toilet Manufacturer' is functionally identical to a 'Bunk House Portable Toilet Supplier' — the product itself is unchanged.
